cross_verification.note_en: Confirmed via the official Embassy of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela in Colombia (colombia.embajada.gob.ve — a gob.ve government domain, Ministerio del Poder Popular para las Relaciones Exteriores), Tourist Visa (T) requirements page. The term 'tamaño carnet' (carnet/ID size) is a common Latin American convention but is not a single fixed measurement, and no exact cm/mm figure was published on this page, so it is not converted to a specific number and no db_conflict is asserted against the DB's '2×2 inch' claim — a direct numeric comparison is not confirmable from this source. Photo background color and exact size were not stated.
